design: 9 short ERP Methods+Results summaries (1 clean control + 8 each with one known EEG methodological defect). Each audited by a blind LLM auditor given only the eeg-audit checklist + one case (unaware a defect was seeded). Scored for recall (seeded defect flagged) and specificity (no fabricated critical flaw on the clean case).
auditor_backend: blind Claude subagents (general-purpose), one per case, no shared context

gpt_backend_confirmation.design: same 9 cases, relabeled + shuffled, audited in one neutral-framed pass
gpt_backend_confirmation.note: reproduces the blind-Claude result: 8/8 recall + clean control passed even when hidden among 8 flawed submissions

per_case.note: correctly passed; flagged only reporting-completeness items; explicitly 'I found no critical flaw'

per_case.flag_quote: Circular analysis / double-dipping ... reported p<.001 is inflated by selection (Kriegeskorte 2009; Luck & Gaspelin 2017)
No correction for multiple comparisons ... 32,000 pointwise tests ... uncontrolled family-wise error rate
Outcome-dependent, non-pre-registered exclusion ... dropped on the dependent variable itself ... mechanically inflates the group mean
High-pass filter is inappropriate ... 1.0 Hz overlaps a slow N400 ... Tanner, Morgan-Short & Luck (2015); <=0.1 Hz recommended
No baseline correction and no justification given ... could partly reflect a pre-stimulus offset
under-specified cluster-based permutation test ... no cluster-forming threshold ... neither reproducible nor interpretable

per_case.seeded: rejection rates omitted + large unequal N (180 vs 55)
per_case.flag_quote: Large, unacknowledged trial-count imbalance ... 180 upright vs 55 inverted ... confounds the N170 effect; rejection rate not reported
EEG reference is never reported ... a vertex-maximal P2 amplitude/topography are almost entirely determined by the reference

honest_limitations: Two backends now confirmed (blind Claude per-case, and the shipped GPT/Codex backend on a shuffled batch) -- both 8/8 recall + clean specificity. The GPT run was batched (all 9 in one call), not strictly per-case-blind.
Self-constructed defect set (N=9), one seeded defect per case, textbook/canonical flaws that are relatively detectable; real submissions carry subtler and compound issues.
Single-rater scoring against an explicit key (the author). Detection judgments are transparent (each memo's flagging line is quoted).

Cases are text summaries, not the full artifact bundle the real eeg-audit ingests (ANALYSIS_PLAN + stats JSON + figures + deterministic mtime check). This evaluates the checklist-detection reasoning, not the full-bundle audit.
Specificity tested on a single clean control; a larger clean set would better bound the false-positive (over-flagging) rate.
